source: on_page_content_parsing (rank 5 organic for both exact and parent term)

structure_summary.positioning: Award-winning, women-led cleaning agency; 'We set the benchmarks that others follow'; City to City; founder story (Paula Rod, Footscray, systematic cleaning formula)
structure_summary.pricing_model: Simple hourly rates, no added fees, no lock-in contracts; explicitly rejects fixed-price quotes; 'you only pay for the hours you book'
trust_signals: Police checked, trained, experienced, trustworthy, friendly checklist
structure_summary.content_depth: VERY deep on-page FAQ (~20 Q&As: contracts, hours needed, quotes, number of cleaners, same cleaner, home access/keys, rescheduling, service areas, gift cards, equipment, payment, receipts, changing cleaner, trust/vetting, overcharge)
structure_summary.detailed_task_lists: Explicit inclusions/exclusions per clean type (bathroom, floors, kitchen; housekeeping add-ons; explicit exclusions e.g. external windows, mould, bio-hazard, washing machines)
structure_summary.social_proof: ~20 named suburb-attributed testimonials (St Kilda, Footscray, Toorak, Brighton, etc.)
structure_summary.editorial_hub: Blog-style trust articles ('Truth About Bargain Cleaners', 'Truth About Premium Cleaning', 'Hourly vs Fixed', 'How many hours does my home need')
structure_summary.gaps_vs_client: single cleaner per home (not pairs); no eco/non-toxic product story; no membership product; no seasonal-deep-clean upgrade concept; premium framing but as a benchmark, not a systematised 'robot standard'
